# Benzinga

Benzinga provides real-time financial news and data APIs, offering comprehensive coverage of market-moving information for developers and financial professionals.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/benzinga/.

## Actions

- **Get Analyst Ratings** (read-only): Fetch analyst ratings calendar data including rating actions, price targets, and analyst details.
- **Get Calendar Earnings Stream** (read-only): Subscribe to real-time earnings calendar events via websocket.
- **Get Consensus Ratings** (read-only): Get consensus analyst ratings and price targets for a specified ticker over a date range.
- **Get Earnings Calendar V2.1** (read-only): Retrieve earnings calendar data (v2.1).
- **Get Newsfeed Stream** (read-only): Stream real-time news events via websocket.
- **Get Conference Calls** (read-only): Retrieve upcoming and historical conference call details such as times, tickers, and webcast urls.
- **Get Economics** (read-only): Retrieve economic calendar events including actual, consensus, and prior values and importance.
- **Get Removed** (read-only): Retrieve removed or cancelled calendar events.
- **Get Removed News** (read-only): Retrieve news articles that have been deleted from the database.
